This performance is not meant to be revered—but to be experienced. A supercharged 3.0-liter
TFSI® V6 engine sits comfortably under the hood of the Audi S5, producing 333 horsepower
and an exhilarating 325 lb-ft of torque, to propel the S5 Coupe to 60 mph in just 4.9 seconds.
We wanted to make sure the thrill you feel behind the wheel is as intense as possible.1
2017 Audi S5 Coupe shown in Misano Red pearl with available equipment.
// Sport differential
To help ensure high cornering stability, the optional sport differential uses torque
vectoring, and then adds to that by mechanically applying torque to the outside
rear cornering wheel. Through an electrohydraulic multiplate clutch pack and
gear set, the outside rear cornering wheel’s speed is increased by as much as 10%
compared to the drive shaft’s.
// quattro® all-wheel drive with sport differential
The quattro® system’s asymmetric torque split
delivers power where it’s needed, from front to back.
And it gets better from there with the addition of
torque vectoring and an available sport differential,
which transfers the rear sent power laterally as need-
ed. Working in tandem, this helps make cornering
more precise and handling more assured.
